# Teach Maryland

> > Official Maryland state resource for aspiring educators, featuring teacher certification pathways, the Teaching Fellows for Maryland Scholarship Program, and National Board Certified Teacher (NBCT) support aligned with the Blueprint for Maryland's Future.

Teach Maryland is the Maryland State Department of Education's (MSDE) central recruitment and information hub for individuals pursuing teaching careers in Maryland. The site provides comprehensive guidance on traditional and alternative certification routes, including the Teacher Academy of Maryland (TAM), Associate Arts in Teaching (AAT), Master of Arts in Teaching (MAT) programs, and the Generation Blueprint initiative.

## Key Topics

- Blueprint for Maryland's Future
- Teaching Fellows for Maryland Scholarship Program
- National Board Certified Teachers (NBCT)
- Teacher Academy of Maryland (TAM)
- Alternative certification pathways
- Associate Arts in Teaching (AAT)
- Master of Arts in Teaching (MAT)
- Career changer programs
- Teacher certification requirements
- Generation Blueprint
- Maryland State Department of Education (MSDE)
- Local school systems and county contacts
- Financial incentives and scholarships
- Educator preparation programs
- Traditional teacher education pathways

## Getting Started

- [Teach Maryland](https://teach.maryland.gov/pages/default.aspx): Homepage for Maryland teacher recruitment with Teaching Fellows & NBCT info
- [Our Vision](https://teach.maryland.gov/Pages/Our-Vision.aspx): Mission & vision aligned with Blueprint for Maryland's Future initiative

## Teacher Certification Pathways

- [Our Teaching Programs](https://teach.maryland.gov/Pages/our-teaching-programs.aspx): Overview of teacher certification pathways including TAM and AAT programs
- [Career Changer](https://teach.maryland.gov/Pages/Career-Changer.aspx): Alternative certification pathways for career changers via MAT programs

## Resources & Support

- [Certification Resource Links](https://teach.maryland.gov/Pages/Certification-Resource-Links.aspx): Resource links for Maryland teacher certification and educator pathways
- [Local School System Information](https://teach.maryland.gov/Pages/lss-information.aspx): Directory of Maryland county school systems with HR contact information
